value.next1Body: If you sign up with email, we send you one link. Open it within a day and you are signed in.
value.next2Title: Tell us what you are making.
value.next2Body: Two quick questions, so your first project starts in the right place.
value.next3Body: Add what you have, say what the video is for, and press run.
value.trustNoCard: No card required. Starting is free.
value.trustReviewed: Every edited cut is scored before you see it. A low score sends it back for another pass.

general.outcome: You have a story. ReelBolt makes the video.
general.before: A camera roll full of clips and a blank timeline.
general.after: A finished cut with the dead air gone, in the shape each channel wants.

creator.outcome: Your first cut, ready while you plan the next video
creator.before: You film all week and edit all weekend.
creator.after: The dead air, false starts and retakes are already gone when you sit down to it.

business.outcome: A video for the shop, the launch or the offer
business.before: You know the business needs video, and you are not an editor.
business.after: The clips on your phone become a finished cut, without you opening an editor.

educator.outcome: Short clips made from the lessons you already teach
educator.before: The point you want to share is buried in a long recording.
educator.after: A few short takes of that point, cut tight, with subtitles when you want them.

nonprofit.outcome: The cause, told well, without an agency budget
nonprofit.before: You have the stories and the clips. Nobody on the team edits.
nonprofit.after: A finished cut to share with your supporters, made from the clips you already have.

software.outcome: A launch video for every release
software.before: You ship every week and announce it with a screenshot.
software.after: A promo video made from your app's own code and its real screens.

agency.outcome: First cuts made for you, ready for your own editor
agency.after: A first cut to react to, then hand off to the editor you already use.
